raw_text:
Smart India Hackathon 2026 is a nationwide initiative by Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell to provide students with a platform to solve some of the pressing problems we face in our daily lives, and thus inculcate a culture of product innovation and a mindset of problem-solving.
    
    The Content Transformation Platform project aims to convert raw unstructured text, documents, images, and videos into high-value multi-format deliverables such as LinkedIn posts, Twitter threads, executive advisories, presentation slides, infographics, and video packages.
    
    Using Google Gemini API's multi-modal capabilities and structured JSON outputs, the platform guarantees full source chunk traceability (c1, c2, c3) so end users can audit every AI claim against original source material.

chunks.text: Smart India Hackathon 2026 is a nationwide initiative by Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell to provide students with a platform to solve some of the pressing problems we face in our daily lives, and thus inculcate a culture of product innovation and a mindset of problem-solving. The Content Transformation Platform project aims to convert raw unstructured text, documents, images, and videos into high-value multi-format deliverables such as LinkedIn posts, Twitter threads, executive advisories, presentation slides, infographics, and video packages. Using Google Gemini API's multi-modal capabilities and structured JSON outputs, the platform guarantees full source chunk traceability (c1, c2, c3) so end users can audit every AI claim against original source material.

analysis.summary: The Smart India Hackathon 2026, launched as a nationwide initiative by the Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell, empowers students to address everyday challenges while fostering a culture of product innovation and problem-solving. Within this context, the Content Transformation Platform project is designed to convert raw unstructured materials—such as text, documents, images, and videos—into diverse, high-value deliverables including LinkedIn posts, Twitter threads, executive advisories, presentation slides, infographics, and video packages. Leveraging the advanced multi-modal capabilities and structured JSON outputs of the Google Gemini API, the platform ensures complete source chunk traceability, allowing users to rigorously audit every AI-generated claim back to its original source material.

linkedin_post.content:
The Smart India Hackathon 2026, a nationwide initiative by the Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell, is fostering a culture of product innovation and problem-solving.

As part of this initiative, the Content Transformation Platform project is designed to convert raw unstructured materials—including text, documents, images, and videos—into high-value deliverables. These include executive advisories, presentation slides, infographics, LinkedIn posts, Twitter threads, and video packages.

By leveraging the multi-modal capabilities and structured JSON outputs of the Google Gemini API, the platform ensures full source chunk traceability. This allows users to rigorously audit every AI-generated claim against the original source material.

Discover how this platform is driving innovation through advanced technology.
